raw.rationale: NSC-632839 is a broad-spectrum ubiquitin-specific protease inhibitor with limited potency and no published lineage-selective PRISM signature, so at 2.5 µM it is unlikely to show strong lineage-specific killing beyond rare context-dependent dependencies. Base rates of 0.2-2.5% per lineage suggest low probabilities across all lineages, with modestly higher values for lineages where USP7/SENP2 dependencies or drug sensitivity are documented (e.g., colorectal, lung, CNS).
